notes.title: Update #1 - Bug fixes, new content, more Pug fun!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

So the first update just went live.
Below is a breakdown of what was included in the update.

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[b]Brand new secret character![/b]
You'll need to earn a few more pug points to unlock this awesome new character.

[b]Two new power ups![/b]
Fireball and Arrows. I'll leave you dudes to figure out how the new power ups work. 

[b]Jukebox baby![/b]
You can now enjoy the game music (Made by the talented Felix Arifin) in the game menu. 

[b]- Control upgrade! [/b]
You can now use the Space bar, Up/Down arrow and W/S keys to control your character.

[b]- Quick play! [/b]
Hitting the space bar in the main menu starts the game.

[b]Lost in space![/b]
We added some new variations of the space biome. A little variation, goes a long way.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed Gringo Pug animation.
- Fixed the name changing 'Anonymous' issue.
- Fixed character unlocking issue.
- Fixed a grammar mistake in the space biome description.
- Fixed one super duper rarely occurring non-passable obstacles.

I didn't want to spoil the surprise and tell everyone what the new character is or how the new power ups work. So, I'll let you find out, I look forward to receiving some feedback. 

Thanks to my partner and the hard working guys that worked on Neo Pug, and thank you to the Pug community for being awesome. We're already working on the next update, you can expect to see more new characters and biomes to come very soon. 

Thanks,

Dan.
ːGringoPugːːNeoHamsterːːBabyRexːːGoldenNeoPugAwardːːNeoPandaːːSuperPugːːPuglifeːːMerryPugmasːːGoldenPugAwardːːPuglifeː
